auth.summary: Local HTTPS(:443) auth of Tapo cameras (libtapocameranetwork). Session type chosen from TDP discovery: tpap object -> TPAP/SPAKE2+; encrypt_type == ["3"] -> secure v3; else legacy. Username always 'admin'; password = cloud account password (or cloud LAT, or md5(deviceId) when unprovisioned). Legacy: login {hashed:true,password:MD5U}. v3: login{cnonce,encrypt_type:'3',username} -> -40413 {nonce,device_confirm=SHA256U(cnonce+SHA256U(pwd)+nonce)+nonce+cnonce} -> login + digest_passwd=SHA256U(SHA256U(pwd)+cnonce+nonce)+cnonce+nonce -> stok,start_seq. lsk/ivb = SHA256('lsk'|'ivb'+cnonce+nonce+SHA256U(cnonce+SHA256U(pwd)+nonce))[:16]; AES-128-CBC/PKCS7 + base64 in {method:securePassthrough,params:{request}} to /stok=<stok>/ds with headers seq and tapo_tag=SHA256U(SHA256U(SHA256U(pwd)+cnonce)+body+seq); seq post-increments. TLS: trust-all + no hostname check (except TPAP tls==2).

control.summary: Camera-local JSON-RPC command catalog (HTTPS :443, POST /stok={token}/ds). Every call is {method, params}; params = {module: {section: data}} built from Module/Section enum strings (section 'null' collapses to {module: data}). Reads select sections via 'name' or 'table' lists. The app always batches calls in multipleRequest {params:{requests:[...]}} and gets result.responses[] with per-item error_code. Feature support is discovered via getAppComponentList (name/version). Covers device info, PTZ (move/step/stop/cruise/calibrate/info), presets, privacy (lens mask), day/night and night-vision modes, LED, manual alarm/siren/alarm config, motion/person/vehicle/pet detection, flip/rotation, audio volume, reboot, time/timezone, SD card, record plan, connection type, and error codes.

media.summary: Media/stream facts for a Windows Tapo client. RTSP (:554 /stream1,/stream2) and ONVIF (:2020) are camera-firmware services; the app only manages the 'Camera Account' (user_management/third_account) and RTSP/ONVIF security config, so RTSP URI patterns are external knowledge. The app's own LOCAL media transport is an HTTP/1.1 long-lived POST to /stream on port 8800 (plain TCP, HTTP Digest auth, per-part AES-128-CBC) or port 28800 (TLS-PSK, no digest), with multipart/mixed framing using boundary '--client-stream-boundary--'. Video arrives as MPEG-TS parts (video/mp2t); control is JSON parts {type:request|response|notification, seq, params}. Talkback uses the same /stream endpoint with a 'talk' request and uploads audio/mp2t parts (default G.711 A-law 8 kHz).

vod.summary: SD-card recording search (searchDateWithVideo / searchVideoOfDay / searchVideoWithUTC / searchDetectionList on the HTTPS JSON API, always wrapped in multipleRequest), playback and download over the local POST /stream multipart media session (JSON control {type:'request',params:{method:'get',playback|download:{...}}}, MPEG-TS parts with X-Data-PTS etc., optional AES payload encryption, 25-part acks), app-side TS demux and MP4 remux, event type enum, SD card status/format, camera account + RTSP/ONVIF security + third-party NVR compatibility commands. ONVIF/RTSP port and discovery facts are external.

cloud.summary: TP-Link ID sign-in (V2 REST API with HMAC-SHA1 X-Authorization signing, AccessKey/Secret are Java string constants), regional URL discovery, MFA, silent re-login, cloud device list (getDeviceListByPage), TDP v2 UDP LAN discovery of cameras (header + CRC32, RSA-OAEP/AES-CBC encrypt_info), cloud<->LAN matching by MD5(deviceId), and how the app connects locally (admin + TP-Link ID password, HD default on LAN).

tpap.summary: TPAP local login of encrypt_type ['4'] cameras: SPAKE2+ (P-256, RFC 9383) pake_register/pake_share with md5/sha256 passcodes and extra_crypt shadows, then an AES-128-CCM binary /stok/ds channel.

lat.summary: Local Access Token (LAT): an opaque per-device string issued by the TP-Link IoT cloud in ThingInfo.localAccessToken (GET {iot-app-server}/v2/things, Authorization 'ut|<token>'). For TPAP pake 2 the app offers passcodes [md5_hex(cloud pw), SHA256_HEX_UPPER(LAT), SHA256_HEX_UPPER(cloud pw)]. The owner app moves the camera's admin credential to the LAT by sending changeAdminPassword (old 'empty', passwd SHA256_HEX_UPPER(LAT)) over the cloud passthrough, so after that only the LAT candidate works locally. Media :8800 digest uses SHA256_HEX_UPPER(LAT) in LAT mode.

items.description: SD playback and SD download use the same local media connection as live view: raw TCP (or TLS) socket to the camera, HTTP/1.1 'POST /stream' with multipart/mixed body boundary '--client-stream-boundary--'; device parts use '--device-stream-boundary--'. First POST carries X-Key-Exchange: 1 (unless already negotiated) and is answered 401 + WWW-Authenticate (Digest) ; client retries with Authorization (Digest over POST /stream). Port comes from the device record (TDP discovery http_port); 8800 is the well-known value from public sources. Each multipart part has headers Content-Type, Content-Length, optional X-Session-Id. Details of digest/key-exchange belong to the live-stream spec.

JSON control messages sent as multipart parts (Content-Type: application/json) on the /stream connection. Envelope: {type:'request', seq:int, params:{method:'get'|'do', <verb>:{...}}}. Responses: {type:'response', seq, result:{error_code, session_id,...}}; notifications: {type:'notification', params:{event_type:..., ...}}; type 'error' also exists. Once a session is open, subsequent parts carry header X-Session-Id: <session_id>.

Open an SD playback session on the /stream connection. params.method='get', key 'playback' (GetVodParams). start_time/end_time are UTC seconds as STRINGS; start_time must be > 0, end_time optional. scale is a rate string. event_type is a list of event codes; when non-empty the app sets filter=true (play only event clips). channels defaults to [0]; streams list optional. client_id is an int chosen by the client. Optional fields: vod_type (0 normal,1 from notification), auto_seek (SeekMethod 0/1/2), auto_switch_date ('0'/'1' continue into next day), player_id, camera_mac (hub child), audio_config, ignore_limit, face_id[], det_origin[], play_channel[], traj_start_time, play_type ('traj_play'|'traj_play_multilens'), data_filter_tag, file_id, range, interval, speed, media_type.

Optional: dev_id, mac (hub child), player_id, last_pts (resume after interruption), audio_config, file_id, range, splmom_snap_id[]. The app caps concurrent clip downloads at 10.
Reply to get download: result {error_code, session_id, range, image_list[], seq_image_lens[]}. Non-zero error_code or empty session_id = failure.

Each device->client media part: Content-Type 'video/mp2t' (MPEG-TS chunk) or 'application/json' (control/notification). Media headers: X-Data-PTS (pts, used as progress; must be >= 0), X-If-IFrame ('1' = keyframe), X-Data-Sequence (part counter), X-Stream-Type (int, stream/lens index), X-Data-PTS-Ext, X-Session-Id, X-If-Encrypt ('1' = payload AES-encrypted), X-Data-Hmac (integrity tag on newer HKDF scheme), X-Nonce (rekey on HKDF scheme).

Receiver ack: every 25 received parts (X-Data-Sequence % 25 == 0) the client sends a JSON notification part with headers X-Data-Received: <seq>, X-Session-Id: <sid>, Content-Type: application/json and body {type:'notification',params:{event_type:'stream_sequence'}}. On pause the download client also sends {type:'notification',params:{event_type:'stream_status',status:'stopped'}}.

Device notifications relevant to VOD (params.event_type). stream_status with status 'finished' marks end of the requested range (download completes; app throws 'video data invalid' if no pts was received). disk_status with status 'offline' = SD card removed (MediaException SD_CARD_OFFLINE). playback_switch_next = playback moved to next clip/day (fields mac, streams). stream_finish has reason enum. connection_closed carries close_reason. heartbeat keeps the link alive.

Media payloads with X-If-Encrypt: 1 are AES (o81.a, key+iv) encrypted. Legacy scheme (Key-Exchange params without algorithm=HKDF): key = MD5(nonce + ':' + password_secret), iv = MD5(username + ':' + nonce), where nonce/username come from the device Key-Exchange header (space-separated k="v" pairs; parsed fields nonce, username, cipher, padding, algorithm, salt). Newer HKDF scheme: key = HKDF(ikm = nonce + ':' + secret, salt, info='stream_hkdf_aes_key', 16 bytes), iv = hex-decoded value, plus HMAC integrity via X-Data-Hmac; X-Nonce in a part re-derives the key. Same mechanism as live view; see live-stream spec for exact secret (password hash) selection.

items.description: Payload is MPEG-TS. The app's own TS demuxer maps PMT stream_type: 0x1B(27)=H.264, 0x24(36)=H.265, 0x90(144)=PCMA (G.711 A-law, TP-Link private), 0x91(145)=PCMU, 0x0F(15)=AAC, 0x0B(11)=Opus, 0x03/0x04=MP3, 0x06=private (checked further). Elementary audio types also include PCM and G722.

Download pipeline: decrypted TS chunks (with pts, iframe flag, stream type) -> app TS demuxer -> video elementary stream remuxed unchanged; G.711 audio decoded and re-encoded to AAC ('audio/mp4a-latm'); written with Android MediaMuxer (format 0 = MPEG-4) to '<name>.mp4'. A Windows client can do the same with FFmpeg/Media Foundation: remux H.264/H.265 to MP4 and transcode pcm_alaw to AAC (or keep the .ts).
